papers.title_en: DYSANOS Generative Dynamic Smooth Arbitrage-free Non-parametric Option Surfaces
papers.authors: Hans Buehler, Blanka Horvath, Anastasis Kratsios
papers.evidence: 用于无套利期权曲面的生成模型，是金融中的AI/ML方法
papers.tldr: 期权市场需要无静态套利的平滑期权曲面生成模型，现有方法难以同时覆盖全期限与行权价。本文提出DYSANOS，首个生成式动态平滑无套利非参数期权曲面模型，以AR(1)作为基线隐状态生成器，并构建完整数据管道。在2020-2025年标普指数期权数据上验证，与纯隐含波动率PCA模型对比，表现出色。研究还检验了动态套利的存在性，为期权曲面建模提供新范式。
papers.abstract_en: This article presents with DYSANOS the first generative market model for smooth SANOS option surfaces for all strikes and expiries which are free of static arbitrage. Our model is designed to generate entire paths of daily spot and option prices for years in the future.   We present a robust and useful if somewhat simplistic baseline hidden state generative model in the form of an AR(1) model. We discuss model setup, data pipeline, and training and investigate numerical resence of dynamic arbitrage. We illustrate model performance on Option Metrics' IvyDB S\&P Index data from 2020 to~2025 and compare it to a pure implied-vol PCA model.

papers.title_en: A Computable Stochastic Riccati Equations Framework for Mean--Variance Portfolio Selection with Multifactor Stochastic Volatility Model
papers.authors: Zhecheng Huang, Guojiang Shao, Lei Wang, Qi Zhang
papers.evidence: 具有随机波动率的投资组合选择框架，与自动化组合管理相关
papers.tldr: 针对随机市场系数下连续时间均值-方差组合选择问题，本文提出一个可计算且可实证的多因子随机波动率模型，捕获状态依赖风险溢价、随机波动率与动态资产相关性。最优控制由随机Riccati方程刻画，并设计迭代BSDE程序从上下两侧逼近，利用线性BSDE提供初始上下界。通过对数变换消除奇异性，结合Deep BSDE与DBDP方法求解，并验证了因子策略在回撤控制和下行风险保护上的优势。
papers.abstract_en: We investigate a computable and empirically implementable framework for continuous-time mean--variance optimal portfolio selection with random market coefficients. The market model is built on a tractable multifactor stochastic volatility structure, which captures state-dependent risk premia, stochastic volatility, and dynamic cross-asset dependence. The optimal control is characterized by stochastic Riccati equations. On the computational side, we design an iterative BSDE-based procedure to approximate the stochastic Riccati equation from above and below, where the initial upper and lower bounds are obtained by solving two linear BSDEs. We then apply a logarithmic transformation to remove the singularity in the SRE, and solve the resulting transformed equation using both Deep BSDE and DBDP methods. The linear BSDE bounds also provide effective initial-value estimates, improving the convergence speed and training stability of the Deep BSDE solver. Empirical experiments based on sector ETF data show that the proposed multifactor mean--variance strategy produces smooth target-return wealth dynamics, with improved drawdown control and downside-risk protection relative to benchmark strategies. These results demonstrate the practical potential of combining stochastic Riccati equations, neural BSDE solvers, and multifactor market modeling for dynamic asset allocation.
